[RDSC.5a.9.2] `window_ns > 0` is required: `active_fraction` is `sliding` only
([LSIG.1.1]). The slot is `Bool`, so the body carries no element type.
`identity_slot_name` is empty for a series keyed `by: none` ([LSER.7.6.2]).
`max_samples` carries the series' `capacity` ([LSER.13.14]), `0` when it
declares none, and a full backing refuses ([LSIG.1.1]). `null_policy` is the
series' `nulls:` policy ([LNUL.8.6]).
